_about: Mythical habitat sealing fragment (List 17 #163) — the data-side twin of #41's presentation grammar. A sealed record contains NO area id, coordinates, or table reference: there is nothing in it to leak. This system provides NO unseal operation — unsealing-by-flag-flip is refused by construction; any future depths content arrives as owner-authored canon with its own records. The Dark Forest depths spawn table is verified EMPTY at build time (dark-forest.spawn-tables.json: depths area, grass table, 0 slots) and this package adds no row to it, ever.

consumerBehaviour.atlasMap (#137/#32): hinted-at-evidence at most, under #85's Leak rule
consumerBehaviour.media (#90): at most a TRACE-class report; never a location
consumerBehaviour.rangeMaps (#102): renders UNSURVEYED (the depths precedent), never a shape
consumerBehaviour.soundEcology (#84): the area sounds of what its tables stock; the depths stock nothing
consumerBehaviour.spawnTables (#7): a sealed species has NO row — appearances, if ever canon-authored, are #30/#99 set-pieces under #52, never table outcomes

dependency: species class read from #41's PROPOSED presentationClass field — until it lands in the sheet standard, the mythical-class set is owner-declared per species (registered in STAGING)
open_register: which species are mythical-class beyond canon's declarations

sealedRecordShape.accessFacts: #12 story.* ids under which canon content may exist — they gate authored content, not a system operation
sealedRecordShape.traceKinds: evidence classes in #41 beat-1 / #89 terms: sign | effect | absence
